notes.title: Seat of War v1.3 Progress update.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, and thanks for playing Seat of War. We have been working on a huge update to the game and it has taken us a little while. Let's get right into this!

What we have added so far:
-New animations to the weapons
-Added the "rifle" for the assault class
-Added a Login system to save kills, deaths, and streaks
-Added a rank system, the more you play the higher rank you are.
And of course, plenty of bug fixes.

What we are still working on before this update will be released.
-AI
The AI is almost complete, just touching things up. The AI will only be avalibale in the new game mode, Free for all.
-Touching up the UI
-Fixing the network lag.

Thanks for reading this update so far, this update is almost out.

You can check the screenshots under the artwork tab in the community hub for this game. Thanks!

notes.title: Update 1.03 is live!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody! Today we bring you the first update to the Early Access version of Seat of War! In this update, we have been
taking the community's suggestions into mind. Lots of things have been changed, and even something new added. Here is what we have
done in this update:

-Changed the max amount of players for a server.
Before they were 2, 4 and 8. Now they are 8, 12 and 20!

-Fixed bug where gun was not rendering when the player spawned.

-Fixed the bug where if a player leaves the server while someone is trying to join, it crashes the game.

-Changed the speed depending on the weapons.
All speeds have been increased.

-Added a new map.
The one you have all been waiting for, a new large map! This map is meant to be
played with the 20 player setting. The new map is called "Factory".


Thank you for reading this and playing the game. Have fun!
